quarterly_data.quarter: NGK Insulators earnings release: Consolidated Financial Results for the Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2026 (April-June 2026): net sales ¥184,147 million (+10.6%), operating income ¥32,631 million (+37.2%), net income attributable to owners of the parent ¥29,374 million (+64.1%). Digital Society Business: demand for semiconductors used in AI increased substantially, raising demand particularly for components for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and HICERAM carriers; segment net sales ¥62,660 million (+32.8%), operating income ¥8,243 million (+53.2%). SPE related (components for semiconductor production equipment) revenue was 41,112 million yen versus 33,272 million yen a year earlier. Full-year forecast unchanged.
